summary: Full validation of LensTranslate MVP (iteration 2). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (root, /languages returns 108 langs with 'auto' first, French->English detects 'French'/'fr' and translates 'Bonjour le monde' -> contains 'hello' with bbox in 0..1, Spanish target returns 'hola'/'mundo', no-text image returns 200 with blocks list without crash, history persistence sorted desc with no _id leak, DELETE /api/history/{id} deletes single, DELETE /api/history clears all). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): loads without red screen, all required testIDs present (start-capture-button, capture-status-pill, target-lang-button, history-button, theme-toggle-button, build-required-banner). Languages screen renders 107 non-auto rows, search 'span' narrows to Spanish, tapping language-row-es returns to home and TO shows 'Spanish'. History screen shows history-empty state. Theme toggle visually switches light<->dark (verified via screenshots — green hero card + light card backgrounds change to dark surface).

ui_bugs.issue: Copy is stale: says 'Point the camera at some text and tap the capture button to get started.' but this app is screen-translation via MediaProjection, not a camera app. Reference: /app/frontend/app/history.tsx:187

action_items: Optional: update history-empty copy in /app/frontend/app/history.tsx:187 from camera-based to screen-capture wording (e.g., 'Start screen translation to see your recent translations here.').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined at line 253 but used at line 173 inside translate() exception path — currently only harmful during Gemini failures. Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` above route handlers.
server.py DELETE /api/history/{item_id} returns 200 with {deleted:0} on missing id — consider 404 for stricter semantics.
server.py translate() persists to Mongo only when blocks are non-empty; empty responses are not recorded (intentional per test).
seed_data_creation: Tests create translation entries via Gemini calls and clean up via DELETE /api/history at teardown. No persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses emergentintegrations Gemini 3 Flash (gemini-3-flash-preview). Use PIL to render text on JPEGs (see french_image_b64 fixture). Full suite runs in ~14s. Frontend web preview correctly renders the JS shell with build-required-banner because the native screen-translator module is Android-only; do NOT attempt to test the native screen-capture flow via web. Theme bg check on document.body returns rgba(0,0,0,0) because RN Web applies bg to inner View — validate via screenshot diff, not body.style.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only cosmetic copy leftover in history empty state.
